participation.context: Spoke the refusal, and did not open the tables.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You left the tables unused. You named the door and refused to write it. You stopped on the word nothing.

title: Rode onto the bridge and named the door

participation.context: Spoke the blank day and did not open the tables.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You named the dry hill and the stones, and you left the leaf blank.

title: Baited at noon and named the dry hill

description: Less good than in the yard

participation.context: Read the old notes, judged them worse, and added nothing.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You opened the tables on what you had already written at home. The lines were smaller than you remembered. You left the stylus where it was.

title: Read the spring notes and left the stylus

participation.context: Chose sleep, and did not write.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You refused to improve the notes. You ended on sleep.
